implemented_requirements.requirement: Directional inputs (arrow keys / WASD) move the snake
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.on_key_press maps keys 'up','w','down','s','left','a','right','d' to direction constants and calls snake.set_direction

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake moves around the board and the board updates each tick
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._game_loop calls self.snake.move() then self._draw() and schedules the next tick with after()

implemented_requirements.requirement: Food items appear on the board and can be eaten
implemented_requirements.evidence: food.py defines Food.respawn() that places food on a free cell; Game._game_loop checks if self.snake.head == self.food.position

implemented_requirements.requirement: Snake grows in length after eating food
implemented_requirements.evidence: When food is eaten, Game._game_loop calls self.snake.grow() which sets grow_pending, causing the next move to keep the tail

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the snake collides with itself
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._game_loop calls self.snake.check_self_collision() and triggers _game_over() on True

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if the snake collides with the boundary
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._game_loop calls self.snake.check_boundary_collision(GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT) and triggers _game_over() on True

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board is redrawn after each move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._draw() deletes previous 'food' and 'snake' tags and redraws them each tick

implemented_requirements.requirement: Current score is shown based on food eaten
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._update_status updates the status bar with f"Score: {self.score}" and is called after each tick
config.DIFFICULTY_LEVELS defines Easy/Medium/Hard/Insane; Game.show_menu creates a button for each level and start_game sets move_interval and score_per_food accordingly

implemented_requirements.requirement: High scores are persisted per difficulty
implemented_requirements.evidence: scoreboard.py implements ScoreBoard that reads/writes a JSON file and Game displays high scores in the menu and status bar

critical_issues: The program requires a graphical environment with Tkinter; it will not run in head‑less environments.
judge.summary: All core features of a classic Snake game are present: directional control, movement, food spawning, growth, collision detection, scoring, difficulty selection, and high‑score persistence. The code is complete and appears runnable, with only the usual dependency on a GUI environment.
